name: variant-picker
title: Variant Picker
description: A product card with colour swatches and sizes: a cursor taps one colour and one size, the product shape changes tint, a ring moves to the chosen swatch and the chosen size fills. Product, price, colours, sizes and the two choices are variables.
useWhen: Showing that a product comes in colours and sizes and how easy it is to pick.
An online shop's product page moment in a promo.
avoidWhen: A price or discount: use price-drop.
A whole checkout flow: use checkout-flow.
author: Mosio

source.technique: cursor and click: a pointer tapping through options with the product reacting

variables.label: Colours
variables.description: Colours separated by semicolons, each as name|#hex, two to five.

variables.label: Colour tapped
variables.description: Which colour the cursor taps (1 is the first).

variables.label: Sizes
variables.description: Sizes separated by semicolons, two to five.

variables.label: Size tapped
variables.description: Which size the cursor taps (1 is the first).

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: The selected swatch ring and size: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Font family name. Geist is loaded by default; another family must be loaded by the host.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
